01 / ABOUT ME

One foot in the code.
One eye on the bigger picture.

Quality is a team capability.
I help build it from the inside.

My career has grown from testing core banking platforms to leading quality engineering for a high-volume cryptocurrency exchange. Along the way, I’ve built automation frameworks, investigated complex financial workflows and helped engineers grow in their craft.

At Quidax, I lead a team of five QA engineers while staying close to the work: writing tests, reviewing automation code and shaping how we validate releases. I bring QA into requirements and design discussions early, so quality starts before the first test runs.

I’m also pursuing an MSc in Cyber Security at the National College of Ireland. Combined with my ISC2 certification, that learning adds a security perspective to my work in software quality.
